component.name: KSipPhone
component.summary: A small SIP phone for KDE Plasma

description.p: KSipPhone is an audio-only SIP softphone that lives in the Plasma system tray. It uses baresip as SIP and media engine and integrates it into the desktop.

ul.li: Incoming calls as KDE notifications with accept and decline
Missed calls with call back from the notification history
Voicemail indicator and one-click mailbox call
LDAP phonebook search with caller name and photo
HD codec indicator, call timer, DTMF keypad, mute and hold
Selectable microphone, speaker and ring device, custom ring tone
Password stored in KWallet, handler for tel: and sip: links
